email_body:
Hi Damiano,

Karma follows your debut Bastard by going back to the origins of Dino, and I liked that the prequel leans into betrayal, ambition and revenge with the same dark humour. Coming to fiction after twenty years creating stories for brands like Sky and Speedo is an interesting path too.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Karma is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Karma best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
